I am an old man with no schooling, and the cost of chemical fertilizer is too high for my pocket. Here on the coast, we grow cassava and coconut with the rains God provides, using the seeds we keep from last season. My children and I will work this plot with our hands, though I may hire a few young men when the weeding is heavy.
